name: informed-gate
quantity: option space available to a consulted population

generations.label: current
generations.source_present: options technically available under the governing instrument
generations.source_nameable: options routed to the affected population before the decision

loop.gate_holder: deciding body holding the information set
loop.citation: population characterized as not informed enough to choose; characterization used as grounds for the deciding body retaining the decision

notes: Loop form fully instanced: gate produces the deficit, deficit justifies the gate. Calibration constraint is live here — 'informed' scored against the deciding body's knowledge base returns situated knowledge as absent, so residents holding place-specific knowledge score zero on a test built from the excluded set. R1 requires scoring against options present in the instrument, never against what the center knows.
